errors.method-not-allowed: That action is not possible here.

combos.title: Combos
combos.subtitle: Combos — colour pairs make themselves
combos.intro: Upload a product, pick a category or style here and say 2 pieces or 3 — every colour pair becomes its own combo on the shop. What you change here changes on the shop at once.
combos.sameColour: Two of the same colour still get the combo price
combos.sameColourOf: Two of the same colour still get the combo price — {name}

price.pieceNoPrice: A piece has no price yet, so the set cannot be sold.
price.notLower: Not lower than the regular {regular}. Customers will pay the regular {regular} and no set saving is shown. Enter a price below {regular} to make it an offer.
price.bagsFollow: sets already in bags move to this price

blocking.NO_PIECES: It needs at least two pieces.
blocking.NO_PAIRS: The rule makes no combos yet.

fixed.title: Fixed combos & customer sets
fixed.intro: Fixed combos you put together, and the groups customers may mix themselves. Prices here are what the bag and checkout use.
fixed.autoText: when the bag has every item of an active combo, the set price is applied by itself — even if the customer added the items one by one.

editor.slugHelp: Small letters, digits and dashes. Shared links keep working: change it only before you share it.
editor.coloursAny: Any colour (tap colours to allow only those):
editor.priceOwner: Only the owner (or someone he allowed) can set a price.
editor.priceBad: The set price is not a number.
editor.previewEmpty: Give it a name and pick its pieces to see the price.

dates.endsHelp: After the end date it stops by itself and moves to the archive; its page stays open.
dates.alwaysHelp: Without dates it runs all the time.

toast.priceSaved: Set price saved — the bag and checkout use it
toast.onNotLive: {name} is on — it sells from its start date
toast.off: {name} is off — moved to the archive; its page says the offer has ended
toast.autoOn: {name} applies by itself when the bag matches
toast.sameOn: {name} — two of the same colour now get the combo price
toast.sameOff: {name} — only different colours get the combo price
toast.created: {name} saved as a draft — switch it on when it is ready
toast.photoMade: {name} — set photo made from the piece photos

how.s1s: Products → New product, “Use in combos” ticked
how.s2t: Pick a category or style, 2 or 3 pieces
how.s3t: The pairs make themselves — promote the link
how.s3s: copy the page link for your ad

defaults.title: Shop default templates
defaults.sub: Used when a rule does not choose its own

rules.title: Combo rules
rules.count: {n} of {total} on · each rule makes its own combo page
rules.empty: No combo rules yet. Make one: pick a category, say 2 or 3 pieces, and every colour pair becomes a combo.

rule.truncated: Only the first {n} are made (the limit for one rule).
rule.noPrice: No price yet — the owner sets it.
rule.noSingle: No single pieces in this section
rule.noSingleHint: sold only as sets, not one by one
rule.upsellNeeds: needs a 3-piece rule — turn on to make one
rule.copied: Page link copied — paste it in your ad

archive.note: Ended and switched-off combos live here — nothing is deleted. Their pages still open and say “this offer has ended”, with live combos beside them, so search ranking and shared links are kept. “Turn on again” brings a rule back on the same link.
archive.empty: Nothing in the archive. Ended or switched-off combo rules come here by themselves.

STYLE.name: Same style
STYLE.hint: e.g. Black + Navy of the same polo

wizard.editing: You are changing {name}. “Save changes” changes the shop at once.
wizard.errWhat: Choose at least one category or product first.
wizard.errPairing: This pairing makes no combos — pick another or add colours.

s1.help: Which products make the combos? A whole category, a style (sub-category) or products you pick — whichever is easier. A new product or a new colour in that category joins by itself later.

s2.help: How many pieces in each combo? Even with 2 pieces you can switch on “add 1 more → 3 pcs” later (step 6).

s3.help: How do the pieces pair? Usually “same style” — Black + Navy of the same polo. For a set like a hoodie + a jogger choose “one from each style”.
s3.coloursHelp: Tap a colour you do not want in combos
s3.same: Two of the same colour also make a pair

s4.help: How is the combo priced? A fixed amount a pack, or a share off the regular price.
s4.label: Combo price
s4.warn: This price is the same as or above the regular price ({regular}) — customers pay the regular price and no saving shows.
s4.rounding: A % price is rounded down to {step}. A combo is never priced above its regular total.

s5.help: Can this combo page also sell one piece at a time? Your rule: a 2-piece combo sells as 2 — not one. Ticked, no single piece shows on this page.
s5.tick: No single pieces in this section
s5.tickHint: no one-by-one sales in this section

s6.help: While a customer takes 2 pieces, they are told “take 1 more — 3 pieces for even less”. A 3-piece rule is made for it by itself.
s6.three: This is a 3-piece combo — “add 1 more” is only for 2-piece combos. Press Next.
s6.tickHint: 1 more makes 3 pieces, a bigger saving

s7.help: These combos go on the shop — each pair's picture is made by itself. A sold-out pair hides; a new colour brings new pairs.
s7.empty: No combos — go back to step 1 or 3.

s8.help: Give it a name and choose the page designs. Once saved the combo page is ready — copy the link below for your Facebook or Google ad.
s8.title: Style name on cards
s8.name: Rule name (for you)
s8.keyFixed: The link stays the same once saved, so a shared link keeps working.
s8.season: Season tab on the combo hub
s8.promoteHelp: Copy it after saving. The page shows only the {n} combos — no single pieces.
s8.promoteSingles: Copy it after saving. The page shows the {n} combos, with single pieces below (you turned that on).

done.count: {n} combos are on the shop now. Copy the link for your ad.
done.draftHelp: Switch it on from its card once it has a price.

toastRule.off: {name} is off — moved to Archive; its pages stay open and say the offer has ended
toastRule.back: {name} is back on the shop — same links as before
toastRule.noSingleOn: No single pieces on the {name} page
toastRule.noSingleOff: Single pieces listed under the {name} combos

tiers.title: What customers can combine
tiers.intro: Customers can only build sets from these groups — nothing else gets a set price. They come from Smart Rules (“Build your own set”).
tiers.liveNote: Customers see this on product pages, in Build a set and in the bag.
tiers.offNote: Off — customers cannot build this set.
tiers.changeNote: Prices and on/off are changed in Smart Rules; a price needs the owner’s OK there.
tiers.empty: No customer sets yet. In Smart Rules, start one from the “Build your own set” template.
